title: Density probe view + analytic sphere baseline
rationale: Even with correct rays, the density field may be too sparse/complex. Add a grayscale probe view of raw density and a simple analytic sphere fill to isolate issues.
deliverables: Debug mode: output single-sample density at entry point as grayscale
Add DensityVolume::FillAnalyticSphere(center, radius, density) compute and invoke before march
Keybind to toggle probe vs marcher output; log mode
implementation: Implement compute shader to fill a sphere in the 3D texture (write float density)
In CS marcher, if 'Probe' mode is on, sample density at first step only and output grayscale
Ensure proper UAV→SRV barriers between fill and probe and march
acceptance: Probe shows a clear circular silhouette matching sphere when camera intersects volume
Switching to marcher yields a coherent attenuated shape with Beer–Lambert
Logs confirm analyticsphere dispatch and successful barriers
test_plan: Capture PIX around analytic fill, verify dispatch and UAV barrier
Compare probe vs marcher views: probe establishes visibility of density data
